title: Status Vault Video Download
summary: Status Vault Video and Image Downloader to Save Status & Business Status
description:
Download and Save Videos and Pictures from Status with the Status Vault app.

The status vault app allows you to download and save all statuses with one click. Now, you can save video statuses offline without any effort. You can also save video statuses and images and repost them to your friends.

Features
- Save Multiple Images and Video Status and Repost them
- Auto Download option available for Quick download
- Managing your Downloads
- Manage your Old Statuses
- Play Downloaded Videos and see Full-screen Images
- Share and re-post the Saved Images and Videos
- Business Status supported
- Direct messaging without saving the contact
- More than 20 Languages supported

How it works
- First, you have to Watch the Status from your original App
- Click the download button to save videos or images to your gallery.

Enable Automatic Download
- Once enabled, you can download the Videos and Images by checking their status.

View and Save in High Resolution
The app allows you to view recent status updates in full resolution, allowing you to see the details of each update.

To view an image or video, click on it and then click the download button to save it to your gallery.

Save to Your Gallery or Share as Your Status

This app is independent and is not affiliated with any 3rd party Applications.
